items: Send back to agent: a person's Issue goes to the retained worker, which re-proves only the rejected criteria in one existing fix round; the reason is kept as a learning, and an interrupted repair resumes without a second charge
A worker waiting on its own question or approval hands the run to the operator with the captured question instead of being nudged
A QA dispatch replay keeps the task's original evidence window
A spent review budget offers an extension only when the run can receive one, and says why otherwise
A prompt left unsent in a busy Codex composer is never counted as delivered
